;Business and economy
*The [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Department of Justice]] returns [[U.S. dollar|US$]]300 million recovered from the [[1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal]] to [[Malaysia]]. The repatriation was due for February, but was delayed due to technical issues and [[2020 Malaysian political crisis|Malaysia's ongoing political crisis]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-1mdb-funds/u-s-returns-another-300-million-of-recovered-1mdb-funds-to-malaysia-idUSKCN21W32W?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on tourism]]
**[[Airbnb]] secures a {{USD|1}}{{nbsp}}billion loan to stay afloat as the pandemic causes worldwide demand for its services to drop. This follows a separate bond deal, also worth US$1 billion, it negotiated last week for similar reasons. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-airbnb-debt/airbnb-secures-new-1-billion-loan-on-top-of-1-billion-bond-deal-idUSKCN21W37H?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Chernobyl Exclusion Zone wildfires]]
**Officials of the [[State Emergency Service of Ukraine]] announce the successful extinguishment of all open fires in the [[Chernobyl Exclusion Zone]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/chernobyl-ukraine-crews-extinguish-forest-fires-in-exclusion-zone/a-53125643 (Deutsche Welle)] 
**The ghost city of [[Pripyat]] was left unscathed by the fire while several abandoned villages burnt to the ground. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/katyagorchinskaya/2020/04/15/fire-destroys-a-third-of-tourist-attractions-in-chernobyl/#58b43fed2467 (''Forbes'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[2020 coronavirus lockdown in India]]
****[[Prime Minister of India|Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] extends [[India]]'s nationwide lockdown until May 3. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/india-nationwide-coronavirus-lockdown-extended-3-modi-200414045543730.html (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Department of Health (Philippines)|Philippine Department of Health]] initiates a nationwide [[COVID-19 testing|"mass" testing]] program, but prioritizes the critically ill and vulnerable. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1658556/world (''Arab News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****The death toll from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in the [[United States]] rises by 2,228 in a single day, the highest number of COVID-19 linked deaths reported in any country in a single day, as total cases rise to over 600,000. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-usa-casualties/us-coronavirus-deaths-set-single-day-record-increase-reuters-tally-idUKKCN21W29D (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[United States and the United Nations]], [[World Health Organization's response to the 2019-20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces the United States is suspending funding of the [[World Health Organization]] (WHO) pending an investigation of its handling of the coronavirus pandemic and [[China and the United Nations|its relationship with China]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/04/14/politics/donald-trump-world-health-organization-funding-coronavirus/index.html (CNN)]
*[[China–Kazakhstan relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Kazakhstan)|Kazakh Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] summons the [[China|Chinese]] ambassador after an article claiming that [[Kazakhs]] are "eager to return to China" and "do not have too many complaints" about [[China–Kazakhstan_relations#History|China's historical invasions]] of [[Kazakhstan]] is published on the private Chinese website [[Sohu]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-kazakhstan-china/kazakhstan-summons-chinese-ambassador-in-protest-over-article-idUKKCN21W1AN?utm_source=reddit.com (Reuters)] 

;Law and crime
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
***[[Turkey]] will free one-third of its prisoners to curb the spread of [[COVID-19]]. At least 45,000 prisoners will be freed until the end of May, with the exception of those accused of [[terrorism in Turkey|terrorist]] offenses, as well as journalists and [[Politics of Turkey|politicians]] accused of plotting the [[2016 Turkish coup d'état attempt|2016 coup attempt]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/turkey-free-thousands-prisoners-due-coronavirus-pandemic-200414005036259.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on religion]]
***[[Jordan]] bans public worship at [[mosque]]s during [[Ramadan]], and will not allow [[Taraweeh|evening prayers]], as a precaution to fight the virus. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-jordan-mosques/jordan-to-ban-mosque-prayers-during-fasting-month-of-ramadan-minister-idUSKCN21W288 (Reuters)]
*A 30-year-old man is arrested and charged with making terroristic threats after he allegedly threatened to kill his father and his ex-girlfriends, as well as blow up the [[List of sculptures in Central Park#Fictional characters|Alice in Wonderland statue]] in [[Central Park]]. Explosive devices are discovered in his [[Upper West Side]] apartment. [https://nypost.com/2020/04/14/man-arrested-for-plot-to-blow-up-alice-in-wonderland-statue-in-nyc/ (''The New York Post'')] [https://news.yahoo.com/york-police-thwart-plot-blow-203705919.html (Yahoo! News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[China]] appoints [[Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps]] general secretary [[Sun Jinlong]] as the new Communist Party Secretary of the [[Ministry of Ecology and Environment]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-environment/china-appoints-sun-jinlong-as-new-environment-ministry-party-head-idUSKCN21V2AV (Reuters)]
*[[Joe Biden 2020 presidential campaign]]
**Former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Barack Obama]] officially [[List of Joe Biden 2020 presidential campaign endorsements|endorses]] his former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]], the [[presumptive nominee]] in the [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries|Democratic Party primaries]]. [https://www.nytimes.com./2020/04/14/us/politics/obama-endorses-biden.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2020 Kiribati parliamentary election]]
**Citizens of [[Kiribati]] cast their votes in the first round of the country's latest [[Elections in Kiribati|parliamentary election]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/414192/kiribati-goes-to-polls-as-normal-despite-covid-19-threat (Radio New Zealand)]
